books.description:
Elisa, a half-human, half-vampire girl, believes the Lockhart triplets are the only people in the world she can truly trust. She wants to become human for them—and spend forever with one of them.

But everything changes when Amber, the maid’s daughter, appears. Again and again, Elisa is abandoned, humiliated, and stripped of her dignity. All for Amber. Finally, she decides to let go and accept her fate: leaving day school behind, transferring to night school, and becoming a vampire.

But when Elisa appears in her night school uniform, held in the arms of a powerful vampire heir, why do the triplets who once threw her away suddenly fall into regret and panic—kneeling before her, begging for forgiveness?
books.title: The Triplets' Final Regret

books.description: Duke is the secret god of his island home, and he loves surfing on his magic Koa wood board more than anything. But the powerful Sea Hag curses him and shrinks his board. To get it back, he has to stay married to Kai, the Sea Hag's  human daughter, for 5 years. Duke helps Kai rise to stardom as a surfer, but Kai thinks Duke is just a worthless house husband. She mistreats him, and falls back in with her ex-boyfriend, a world famous surfer. When the five years are up and the curse is lifted, Duke must choose – stay with Kai and hope she recognizes his worth or divorce her and live life on his own terms?
books.title: Surf God's Revenge

books.description: On the eve of her wedding to Zuma, Teyo discovers her sister, Malin, has seduced her betrothed to evade being sacrificed to Huitzil, the feared God of War. Heartbroken, Teyo refuses to marry a cheater, but when Huitzil witnesses her confrontation, he demands Teyo be sacrificed in Malin's place. But the God spares her life and takes her to his realm, where their dangerous attraction soon becomes something neither can resist. When Malin's manipulations as a dark sorceress are revealed, Zuma's remorse rekindles old feelings and threatens to pull her away from the God she has come to love.
books.title: The Virgin Sacrifice Who Seduced a God

books.description: Violet gave seventeen of her life to her fated mate — Kaden Cross. She grew up by his side, devoting everything to him. But when the whole pack turns on her for being a "wolfless burden," Kaden is the one leading their attack, bullying Violet with her stepsister. Humiliated, devastated, betrayed, Violet opens her eyes and makes a choice. She breaks their mate bond and leave this monstrous place behind. The heir to the strongest pack in the realm, Sebastian, arrives to pick her up. His quiet, never-wavering trust is the one to coax her sleeping wolf awake. But right as Violet's about to break free and start again— the man that cast her out is the one on his knees, begging for her to come back.
books.title: After the Alpha's Cruel Trials

books.description: Rian, Duke Calder's disgraced second son, was secretly raised by the Holy Dragon Aurelian, the realm's last Dragon Speaker. When half-orcs threaten Princess Isabel, Rian defeats them one by one, exposing years of family abuse and clearing his mother Elena's honor. The Sovereign names him Dragon Speaker, but he must prove it against Starspeaker Aether before the Undead Legion's general invades. Betrayed by envoy Zoramus, Rian summons Aurelian, destroys the general, and returns to marry Isabel.
books.title: Roaming the World Untamed

books.description: A boy once saved a god's life. Sixty years later, with his own life running out, that now old man begs the god for three more years. So the Sea God marries into the family in disguise, as nothing more than a fisherman. For three years he serves in silence while his wife looks right through him, still chasing an old flame who never deserved her. When the clock runs out, so does his patience — he tears up the contract and walks. Now she's the one left begging for a second chance.
books.title: The Sea God's Disguise: Fishing for Love

books.description: Nothing exciting ever happens to Ryan Collins, the average nerd next door. Until one day, her best friend (and popular football prodigy) breaks down her door hiding from his ex. One thing leads to another, and the two hook up that night. Unbenkownst to Carsen, who has to leave for NFL training the next day, Ryan's pregnant. She lets him leave without telling him--after all, she'd only ruin his life. He'll forget all about her, now that he's a famous athlete...right?
books.title: Worth the Chase

books.description: The world's greatest secret agent must protect and care for his six-year-old daughter while posing as her nanny.
